key_points: IPP Greenvolt secured a €218 million financing package from UniCredit for two 200MW/800MWh battery projects in Poland.
Developer Enlight purchased a 125MW ready-to-build battery energy storage system in Finland from Korkia.
UAB Elesela reached financial close with Artea Bank for a 20MWh battery project in Lithuania.
European Energy appointed Capalo AI to optimize two solar-plus-storage projects in Lithuania and Latvia.
GEN-I Sonce enlisted Waldevar Energy to construct a 55MW/220MWh battery project in Romania.
summary: A roundup details recent financing and contracting moves for battery energy storage systems in Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Finland, and Romania. Greenvolt secured a €218 million package for two Polish projects, while Enlight acquired a Finnish BESS from Korkia. UAB Elesela reached financial close on a Lithuanian project, and European Energy hired Capalo AI to optimize hybrid parks in Lithuania and Latvia. Additionally, GEN-I Sonce enlisted an EPC firm to build a Romanian battery project.
title: Five developers advance large-scale battery projects across Central and Eastern Europe
